content: The question similarity dataset of SemEval 2016 Task 3B (SemEval-cQA) BIBREF3 contains 3,869 question pairs and aims to re-rank a list of related questions according to their similarity to the original question. The same dataset was used for SemEval 2017 Task 3 BIBREF4 .
